Title: Insurance Recommendation Logic

Name: AAPT21AntithyroidAntibodySchedule
Title: AAP T21 Anti-Thyroid Antibody Screening Schedule
Description: Anti-thyroid antibody screening for Trisomy 21 patients per AAP guidelines. At least once in the first year of life. A positive result triggers a cadence change in the TSH screening schedule (see aap-t21-tsh-schedule).
Action Description: Anti-thyroid antibody measurement at least once within the first year of life, unless a result already exists.

Name: AAPT21CBCSchedule
Title: AAP T21 CBC Schedule
Description: Complete blood count for Trisomy 21 patients per AAP guidelines. Initial CBC by day 3 of life, then annually through age 21 to monitor for hematologic abnormalities.
Action Description: Complete blood count by day 3 of life.

Name: AAPT21EarlyInterventionReferralSchedule
Title: AAP T21 Early Intervention Referral Schedule
Description: Early intervention referral for Trisomy 21 patients per AAP guidelines. All T21 patients should be referred to early intervention for speech, fine motor, or gross motor therapy before 3 years of age.
Action Description: Referral to early intervention for speech, fine motor, or gross motor therapy before 3 years of age.

Name: AAPT21FeedingAssessmentSchedule
Title: AAP T21 Feeding Assessment Schedule
Description: Feeding assessment or video swallow study for Trisomy 21 patients per AAP guidelines. Indicated when marked hypotonia or underweight status (below 5th percentile weight-for-length or BMI) is documented. No specific time window â€” applies whenever the clinical findings are present.
Action Description: Order feeding assessment when marked hypotonia or underweight is documented.

Name: AAPT21HearingAssessmentSchedule
Title: AAP T21 Hearing Assessment Schedule
Description: Objective hearing assessment (e.g., ABR or OAE) for Trisomy 21 patients per AAP guidelines. All T21 patients should receive an objective hearing assessment within the first 6 months of life.
Action Description: Objective hearing assessment (ABR or OAE) within the first 6 months of life.

Name: AAPT21KaryotypeSchedule
Title: AAP T21 Karyotype Confirmation Schedule
Description: Karyotype analysis to confirm Trisomy 21 diagnosis per AAP guidelines. Should be performed prenatally where possible; if no prior karyotype result documenting Trisomy 21 exists, a single karyotype analysis should be performed at any point from the prenatal period through age 21.
Action Description: Order a karyotype analysis if no prior karyotype result documenting Trisomy 21 is recorded.

Name: AAPT21OphthalmologyReferralSchedule
Title: AAP T21 Ophthalmology Referral Schedule
Description: Ophthalmology referral for Trisomy 21 patients per AAP guidelines. All T21 patients should be referred to ophthalmology by 6 months of age.
Action Description: Referral to ophthalmology by 6 months of age.

Name: AAPT21TSHSchedule
Title: AAP T21 TSH Screening Schedule
Description: TSH screening protocol for Trisomy 21 patients per AAP guidelines. Default annual cadence switches immediately to semi-annual (every 6 months) upon detection of anti-thyroid antibodies (SNOMED 165775009). All recurring screens use a +/-1 month window and stop at age 21.
Action Description: Initial TSH screen within the first month of life.

Name: AAPT21TTESchedule
Title: AAP T21 Transthoracic Echocardiogram Schedule
Description: Transthoracic echocardiogram for Trisomy 21 patients per AAP guidelines. All T21 patients should receive a TTE within the first month of life to evaluate for congenital heart defects.
Action Description: Transthoracic echocardiogram within the first month of life.
